info.description:
One backend, two clients (web and Flutter).

**Compatibility:** additive changes only within `/v1` — no removed or renamed
fields, no newly-required request fields, no narrowed types. App Store users
stay on old builds for months. Clients must treat unknown enum values as
"other". See docs/architecture.md §7.

**Errors** are always `{"error": {"code", "message", "details"}}`. Switch on
`code`; never parse `message`.
info.title: Nakhatra API

post.description: Answers a question against an already-computed chart. The chart is supplied by the caller and read, never recalculated — the model is not asked to derive positions or dates.
post.summary: Ask the astrologer about a chart

post.description:
Computes a full Vedic chart from birth details: Lahiri ayanamsa, whole-sign houses, mean nodes, Vimshottari dasha. Deterministic and synchronous — the calculation is local arithmetic against an ephemeris, not a job.

See docs/astrology-methodology.md for every methodology decision.

parameters.description: Dasha levels to return: 1 maha, 2 +antar, 3 +pratyantar. Defaults to 2 — the full tree is 819 periods and ~78KB, against ~12KB for two levels. Request 3 only when drilling into a specific period.
parameters.name: dasha_depth

schema.description: Dasha levels to return: 1 maha, 2 +antar, 3 +pratyantar. Defaults to 2 — the full tree is 819 periods and ~78KB, against ~12KB for two levels. Request 3 only when drilling into a specific period.
schema.title: Dasha Depth

get.description:
Prefix search over 786,650 populated places. Every populated place in Nepal and India, plus everywhere worldwide with population >= 1000.

Alternate names are searched too — GeoNames records Lumbini under the primary name 'Rummin-dei', so searching primary names alone would make it unfindable.

Each result carries an **IANA zone name**, resolved here rather than guessed by the client.

post.description: Reads an already-computed chart. `source` says whether the model or the deterministic generator produced it; both return the same seven sections.
post.summary: Generate a seven-section reading for a chart

get.description:
Serve a cached mp3.

Deliberately unauthenticated: the browser fetches this from an `<audio>` tag,
which sends no Authorization header. The name is a SHA-256 of the text, so it
is unguessable, and `cache.path_for` rejects anything that is not a name this
service could have written.
